topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, the course framing, and the core learning outcomes concerning cancer causation and carcinogen appraisal.

topics.label: Origins of Cancer and Environmental Versus Endogenous Risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological nature of cancer as an evolutionary disease and evaluate the relative contributions of endogenous mutations, genetics, and environmental exposures to cancer development.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Mutagenic Carcinogens and Metabolic Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how various environmental carcinogens induce DNA damage directly or through host metabolic activation and oxidative stress.

topics.label: Tumor Promotion, Inflammation, and Host Cell Susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how non-mutagenic mechanisms such as chronic inflammation, chemical promoters, and specific developmental life stages create permissive environments for tumor growth.

topics.label: Methodologies for Detecting and Testing Carcinogens
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the genomic signatures, epidemiological strategies, animal models, and in vitro assays used to identify and evaluate carcinogenic substances.
